mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE drops by more than 0.5% in a month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS drops by more than 5% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% MoM and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) YoY growth is below 2%, it signals a potential monetary policy pivot, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE drops by more than 0.2% and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator for broader economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for three consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals a loosening monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and boosts equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25% in a month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.
